title: Italian Frittata with Baked Bryndza
description: A traditional Italian omelette-style dish made with bryndza cheese and other flavorful ingredients, perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Whisk eggs, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, add onion, and cook until softened.
Add bryndza and cook for another 2 minutes.
Pour the whisked eggs over the bryndza mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with italian cheese.
Return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven, let it cool for a minute, and slice into wedges.
